name: Prince Doran
backstory: Head of the Salthos house, which has governed the crossing for three generations; personally talked both houses down once the tollhouse dispute cooled.

experience.text: Heard that Niemus and Darius now have a child, Niemius.
Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnakus.
Had a child with Nakus, named Dorakus.
Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Had a child with Niemius, named Niemoran.
Heard that Nakus and Niemus now have a child, Niekus.
Had a child with Nakus, named Dornakus.
Had a child with Nakus, named Nakoran.
Had a child with Nakus, named Dorukus.

criterion.standard: counts the arrears settled plainly above another dispute merely kept quiet a while longer
criterion.wasted_life: letting a shortfall everyone can already see go unaddressed until it curdles into exactly the kind of open grievance his house exists to prevent
criterion.derivation: collision between his backstory (head of the house that talked both cities down from war once already) and the sample's own toll_ledger_arrears (a live financial dispute with Gorff)
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

history.note: re-derived after encodings.json gained three new concrete concepts (crossing_market_roof, toll_ledger_arrears, forliamus_betrothal_offer) via /tell, at the author's explicit direction, to diversify arcs away from the epistemic-conflict default

routines.routine_actions: holds court at the square each morning, hears disputes referred up from Terfila or Gorff, walks the crossing's edge at dusk to see it's quiet

arc.premise: Doran wants the toll arrears settled in the open - an actual accounting, agreed by both sides, of what's owed and why it's short - before it curdles into exactly the kind of grievance his own house exists to keep from becoming a war.
